common.title: Biological Incident
common.line: A real biological incident with model involvement: a deliberate release or a laboratory escape involving a designed or modified agent.

common.title: The 2028 US Presidential Election – Alliance
common.line: The United States elects a president, and the administration concludes that a coalition beats a fortress, and that a technologically hollowed-out Europe is a liability rather than a convenience.

common.title: The 2028 US Presidential Election – Consolidation
common.line: The United States elects a president, and advanced AI is treated as a strategic asset to be held rather than a product to be sold.

common.title: Reasoning Stops Being Legible
common.line: The frontier models no longer allow intermediate reasoning a human can read, because the representations that work best are not words and never were.

notable.title: Taiwan Blockade
notable.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Grid connection freeze
notable.line: Coordinated municipal moratoriums on new data-centre grid connections spread across several member states after hospital outages and power-cost protests, freezing non-gigafactory AI build-out through winter.
